svg.title: Bridge template cache before and after the fix
svg.desc: Two panels with Wilson 95 % intervals. a) Own blocks missing a tip the node already knew: before 46.7 % (1154/2469), after 8.5 % (144/1689); with the tip at least 50 ms old: before 32.2 %, after 0.18 %. b) Red share: own miner before 2.07 %, after 0.95 %; all other miners before 8.05 %, after 6.78 %. Pre-registered difference-in-differences +0.15 pp, 95 % CI -0.61 to +0.91: not significant.
